messages.tip.action_button: Runs this action using the current data and parameter values.
messages.tip.angle: מינימום angular separation, in degrees, between accepted density maxima. Larger values keep fewer, more widely separated ראשי poles; smaller values may retain nearby peaks from the same orientation משפחה.
messages.tip.bins: Sets the KDE density-grid level as 2^N cells per axis. Higher values reveal finer density detail but require more memory and computation. Use the lowest value that resolves stable density maxima.
messages.tip.classify_action: Assigns each point to the closest reviewed ראשי pole within the JS cone threshold and writes the JS שדה סקלרי. The reviewed pole table, not the original automatic peaks, is used.
messages.tip.colour.dof: Select the number of rotation degrees of freedom. Use 2 for the original two-angle rotation model or 3 for the intrinsic Z-Y-X Euler rotation used by the three-degree-of-freedom model.
messages.tip.colour.objective: Select the objective function minimised during optimisation. It controls how the rotated pole orientations are penalised or distributed in the colour reference system.
messages.tip.colour.subsample: Percentage of valid point נורמלים used during optimisation. Lower percentages reduce computation time; 100% uses all valid נורמלים.
messages.tip.colour.iterations: מקסימום number of differential-evolution generations. Higher values allow a more extensive search but increase computation time.
messages.tip.colour.population: Population multiplier used by differential evolution. Larger values evaluate more candidate rotations per generation, increasing search effort and computation time.
messages.tip.colour.seed: Optional integer random seed. Enter a value to make the sampling and optimisation reproducible; leave blank to use a new random seed.
messages.tip.colour.export_copy: Creates a new CloudCompare ענן נקודות coloured using the selected colour space and the selected pole space. The original ענן נקודות is not modified.
messages.tip.colour.show_density: Displays the relative pole-density distribution obtained with the optimised rotation. It does not run the optimisation again.
messages.tip.colour.show_poles: Displays the point-נורמל poles after applying the optimised rotation, using the selected stereonet projection.
messages.tip.clouds: When פאות are created, also creates one separate ענן נקודות for each סופי אשכול. Disable this for very large datasets if the additional clouds use too much memory.
messages.tip.cluster: Runs DBSCAN independently within each positive JS משפחה, estimates a משפחה-specific eps, removes components smaller than ppcluster, fits מישור equations, and writes cl, A, B, C, D and sigma using the original global point indices.
messages.tip.colour.optimise: Starts the נורמל-colour optimisation with the parameters entered above and determines the rotation angles that minimise the selected objective function.
messages.tip.dbscanminpts: מינימום number of points inside the DBSCAN neighbourhood, including the point itself, required for a core point. The MATLAB method uses 4. Increasing this value requires denser neighbourhoods and may classify more points as noise.
messages.tip.density_action: Calculates the KDE pole-density surface and extracts automatic ראשי poles. Review and, if necessary, edit the resulting pole table before assigning JS משפחות.
messages.tip.editable_param: Editable parameter. Enter a numeric value where appropriate; the associated label indicates the units and the parameter effect.
messages.tip.facets: Creates one convex planar mesh for each valid סופי אשכול using its stored global point indices and fitted מישור. Clustering must be completed first.
messages.tip.family_clouds: After clustering, creates one ענן נקודות for each positive JS משפחה. Each ענן נקודות contains that משפחה’s points and retains the JS, cl and מישור שדות סקלריים.
messages.tip.family_plot_action: Plots point נורמלים coloured by their current JS value and overlays the reviewed ראשי poles. This is available only when JS corresponds to the current reviewed pole table.
messages.tip.fix: When selected, each אשכול in a JS משפחה uses the reviewed משפחה-pole נורמל and derives only D from the אשכול centroid. When cleared, each אשכול נורמל is fitted locally using PCA/SVD.
messages.tip.jscone: מקסימום angular difference, in degrees, between a point נורמל and a reviewed ראשי pole. The closest pole inside this cone defines JS; points outside all cones receive JS=0.
messages.tip.kneighbor: Neighbour order used to estimate eps separately for each JS משפחה. The MATLAB method uses K=4 and queries K+1 neighbours because the first result is the point itself. Larger K represents a broader local spacing scale.
messages.tip.ksigma: Multiplier in eps = mean(unique KNN distances) + k_sigma × sample standard deviation. The MATLAB method uses 2. Larger values increase eps and tend to join components across wider gaps; smaller values tend to split אשכולות.
messages.tip.labels: Shows cardinal directions, angular guides and stereonet annotations. These guides are visual only and do not affect the calculations.
messages.tip.maxpoles: מקסימום number of automatic ראשי poles retained from the density surface. It limits the candidate JS משפחות; the reviewed pole table remains authoritative and can be edited manually.
messages.tip.merge: Coplanarity threshold based on |Di-Dj|/(sigma_i+sigma_j). Larger values merge more same-משפחה אשכולות into a common מישור; smaller values preserve more separate מישורים. Set 0 to disable this merge.
messages.tip.minclustersize: מינימום component size after DBSCAN, corresponding to MATLAB ppcluster. Components with fewer points are rejected and assigned cl=0. This does not control whether a point is a DBSCAN core point.
messages.tip.plot_poles: Plots all valid point נורמלים as poles on the selected stereonet projection. This is a visual inspection step and does not modify the ענן נקודות.
messages.tip.pole_add: Adds a new ראשי pole from the כיוון נטייה and נטייה values. The table and density plot update immediately; משפחה IDs are renumbered and existing JS and אשכול results become outdated.
messages.tip.pole_apply: Applies the כיוון נטייה and נטייה values to the selected ראשי pole. The reviewed table becomes the source of truth, so JS classification and clustering must then be recalculated.
messages.tip.pole_delete: Deletes the selected ראשי pole, renumbers the remaining משפחות and refreshes the plot. Existing JS and אשכול results become outdated.
messages.tip.pole_down: Moves the selected pole one row down. Because table order defines J_1, J_2, etc., this changes משפחה IDs and requires JS classification and clustering to be recalculated.
messages.tip.pole_move: Changes the משפחה order. Because משפחה IDs follow table order, changing the order requires JS classification and clustering to be recalculated.
messages.tip.pole_table: Authoritative reviewed list of ראשי poles. JS classification, משפחה plots, Fisher K and subsequent clustering use this exact order and orientation. Editing or reordering the table invalidates existing JS and אשכול results.
messages.tip.pole_up: Moves the selected pole one row up. Because table order defines J_1, J_2, etc., this changes משפחה IDs and requires JS classification and clustering to be recalculated.
messages.tip.poles.source: Choose whether pole plots, density and automatic peak detection use the original נורמלים or נורמלים transformed by the optimised rotation. Stored ראשי-pole orientations always remain in the original reference system.
messages.tip.projection: Selects the stereographic projection used for plots. שווה-זווית preserves angular relationships; equal-area preserves area. This setting changes only the visual projection, not the original point נורמלים or שדות סקלריים.
messages.tip.refresh: Refreshes the selected CloudCompare entity and checks which workflow actions and כלים commands have the data required to run.
messages.tip.seed: Optional integer used only with אקראי אשכול ordering. The same seed reproduces the numbering; leave blank to generate a new random order for each run.
messages.tip.show_density: Displays the last computed density and current ראשי poles without recalculating the KDE or detecting peaks.
messages.tip.sort: Controls סופי cl numbering within each JS משפחה. Size orders the largest אשכולות first, D follows their spatial position along the fitted נורמל, and אקראי shuffles the order. IDs restart at 1 for each משפחה.
messages.tip.style: Chooses line contours or filled contours for the density plot. This changes visualisation only; density values and detected poles are not recalculated.

messages.about.body:
Authors:
  Adrián Riquelme Guill
  Roberto Tomás Jover
  Antonio Abellán Fernández
  University of Alicante

Scientific references:
  Riquelme, A.J., Abellan, A., Tomas, R., & Jaboyedoff, M. (2014).
  A new approach for semi-automatic rock mass joints recognition
  from 3D point clouds. Computers & Geosciences, 68, 38-52.
  https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cageo.2014.03.014

  Riquelme, A.J., Abellan, A., & Tomas, R. (2015).
  Discontinuity spacing analysis in rock masses using 3D point clouds.
  Engineering Geology, 195, 185-195.
  https://doi.org/10.1016/j.enggeo.2015.06.009

  Riquelme, A., Tomas, R., Cano, M., Pastor, J.L., & Abellan, A. (2018).
  Automatic mapping of discontinuity persistence on rock masses using
  3D point clouds. Rock Mechanics and Rock Engineering, 51, 3005-3028.
  https://doi.org/10.1007/s00603-018-1519-9

  Riquelme, A., Tomas, R., Cano, M., Pastor, J.L., & Abellan, A. (2026).
  Orientation-based colour mapping and spherical density analysis for
  rock discontinuity detection in 3D point clouds of roadcut slopes.
  Journal of Rock Mechanics and Geotechnical Engineering.
  https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jrmge.2025.12.059

  Riquelme Guill, A. (2015).
  Uso de nubes de puntos 3D para identificación y caracterización de
  familias de discontinuidades planas en afloramientos rocosos y
  evaluación de la calidad geomecánica. Doctoral thesis, University of
  Alicante.
  https://rua.ua.es/entities/publication/78d254b9-1a7b-49b1-a35a-c0edbdeeb225

Based on:
  Adrian Riquelme's MATLAB implementation of the Discontinuity Set
  Extractor (DSE), Department of Civil Engineering, University of
  Alicante, Spain.

Libraries and algorithms:
  - NumPy: numerical arrays and vector operations.
  - SciPy: KDE, differential evolution, nearest-neighbour queries,
    connected components and convex-hull geometry.
  - Matplotlib: stereonet, density and analysis plotting.
  - colorcet: scientific and perceptually useful colour maps used by
    the אשכול visualisation.
  - Pillow: icon loading, resizing and GUI icon normalisation.
  - CloudCompare / pycc: point-ענן נקודות, נורמל and scalar-field access.
  - Tkinter / ttk: graphical user interface.
  - PyVista (optional): interactive 3D נורמל/sphere visualisation.

  Algorithms and methods:
  - DSE ראשי-pole extraction using spherical/steronet KDE, based on
    the Botev et al. kernel-density approach.
  - Differential Evolution for נורמל-colour rotation optimisation.
  - DBSCAN (Ester et al., 1996) for spatial clustering of discontinuity
    משפחות.
  - Fisher directional statistics for mean-pole concentration and
    confidence intervals.
  - cKDTree nearest-neighbour searches and Qhull convex-hull geometry
    through SciPy.

Acknowledgments:
  CloudCompare development team and the researchers whose methods
  underpin the DSE workflow.
messages.colour.angles_unit_note: Rotation angles are expressed in degrees (°). Edit the values and press החל angles to use them manually.
messages.colour.error.invalid_angles: Rotation angles must be finite numeric values.
messages.log.colour.manual_angles: Manual colour rotation applied: angles=[{angles}], objective={value:.6g}.
messages.tip.colour.rotation_angle: Rotation angle in degrees. For 3 degrees of freedom these fields are the intrinsic Z-Y-X Euler angles: Z (yaw), Y (pitch) and X (roll). For 2 degrees of freedom only the first two angles are used.
messages.gui.normal_spacing_save_error: Could not save the נורמל spacing results: {error}
messages.gui.spacing_family: משפחה to analyse. Select הכול to calculate the נורמל spacing for every available discontinuity set.
messages.gui.spacing_bandwidth: KDE bandwidth for the נורמל-spacing distribution. Enter 0 to select the bandwidth automatically.
messages.gui.spacing_minimum: מינימום נורמל spacing retained in the analysis. Values at or below this threshold are filtered out before calculating the density curves.
messages.gui.spacing_dtolerance: Tolerance used to group אשכול מישורים with the same fitted D value. Smaller values require closer D values to be considered the same מישור.
messages.gui.persistence_family: משפחה to analyse. Select הכול to calculate persistence for every available discontinuity set.
messages.gui.persistence_dtolerance: Tolerance used to group אשכולות with the same fitted D value into a single מישור before persistence is calculated.
messages.gui.persistence_export: Also save the persistence tables and figures to the selected folder.
messages.progress.spacing_plane: מישור {position} of {total}: searching the nearest different מישור...
messages.progress.roughness_profile_prepare: DS {family}, אשכול {cluster}: profile {profile}/{total}: preparing local מישור...
